card.name: Punctuation inside textbook citations
card.fires_on: Commas and periods in reference lists of medical textbooks, such as after editor initials, after 'ed', or before the publisher. Also punctuation in textbook publisher blurbs.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Comma or period after editor names, edition number, or city in a textbook reference.
modes.example: Mahan LK, Escott-Stump S, eds. Krause’s Food, Nutrition, and Diet Therapy. 10th ed<<.>> Philadelphia, PA: WB Saunders Company;
